[LIMP.13.1] **Every schema has one own name.** The
compiler must give each schema the own name its declaration's place decides:

| Declared in | Own name |
|---|---|
| the file being compiled | its `NAME` |
| a library | the library's dotted import path, a `.`, and its `NAME`: `plant.sensors.Reading` |
| the built-in module ([LIMP.12.1]) | its `NAME` |

The path is the one [LIMP.3.1.4] resolves. It is never an `as` alias, a
search-path entry or a file path. A schema reached through a re-export
([LIMP.4.4.1]) has the own name the library that declares it gives it. A
synthetic schema's name is [LLEX.10.6.1]'s.

So no two distinct schemas of a program share an own name: a `NAME` holds no `.`
([LIMP.4.3.4]), a path resolves to one file ([LIMP.3.1.3]), and a file declares
a `NAME` once.
